previous_statement: At a Stage-1 raw call satisfying the respective producer hypotheses, lem-maincb-stage1-call-envelope (whose construction incorporates lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement) gives the literal u_1 as an extended D_1 t-inclusion with unit error at most D_1 t; hence both bounds hold with D_* t.
new_statement: At a Stage-1 raw call satisfying the respective producer hypotheses, lem-maincb-stage1-call-envelope (whose construction incorporates lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement) gives the literal u_1 as an extended D_1*t-inclusion with ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A|| <= D_1*t; because 0 <= t and D_1 <= D_*, the numerical unit-error bound weakens to ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A|| <= D_*t. Under the currently registered definitions and externals this does not imply that u_1 is an extended D_*t-inclusion; that separate monotonicity bridge is required for the corresponding clause of the root.
